description: Convenience for AES-GCM encryption: generates an IV, encrypts data, and returns a sealed object { algorithm, keyLength, iv, tag, ciphertext }. Equivalent to crypto_encrypt({ name: "AES-GCM" }, key, data) with an auto-generated IV. Use stringify() (and optional pure-JSON field mapping) to store the result. Requires execute access.

parameters.description: Key material, CryptoKey, or key reference.
parameters.name: key

parameters.description: Plaintext (base64Binary or hexBinary). Use encode_as_base64Binary() for UTF-8 text.
parameters.name: data

returns.description: Sealed object with algorithm, keyLength, iv, tag, and ciphertext.
